title: Out-of-state Schedule III through VI prescriptions
rule_summary: An authorized out-of-state practitioner may issue a Schedule III through VI prescription filled in Massachusetts within 30 days of issue; Schedule III through V prescriptions require pharmacist verification.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply out-of-state iii-vi requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Out-of-state Schedule III through VI prescriptions

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing out-of-state iii-vi with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
